name: Yamato (Kagoshima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yamato village emblem in blue: a ring crossed by a winged horizontal bar.
history: Municipal flag of Yamato, a village in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Yamato village emblem — a ring crossed by a winged horizontal bar
